about: drishti-views' speed budgets (VIEWS_DESIGN 12.3, 12.4). A budget is loosened only by a commit that says why. Browser timings are checked as a ratio to a calibration loop run in the same page (calibration-ms is that loop's time on the reference machine), so a slow runner does not fail a good change. first-paint-ms: a 12-panel view's frame drawn after its JSON arrives (P1); ready-ms: every panel drawn or in a state (P2); patch-apply-ms: one frame of strip and panel patches applied (P3, the script part); patch-to-pixel-p99-ms: from handing a frame to the painter to the next animation frame (P3); validate-200kb-ms: a 200 KB view validated in Node (P9), checked as a ratio to node-calibration-ms (a JSON copy of the same view, timed in the same process on the reference machine), so a busy machine does not fail a good change.
